svg.title: AIWorkHub ecosystem
svg.desc: Poster of the AIWorkHub ecosystem: a Task MCP control plane spine that carries work from owner to learning commit, surrounded by six panels for the manager seat, the multi-model workforce, the memory layer, Source Graph, quality gates and the NeedFix loop.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: A self-hosting coding factory — one manager seat, many models, acceptance by measurement
Bootstrap verifies repository identity before any file access
Routes cards by difficulty and cost
Accepts by measurement, never by asking
Rejects with exact ranges and the fix shape
Claude Haiku / Sonnet / Opus · Codex · DeepSeek ·
Gemini Argon · Muse · GLM · Grok · Kimi · Qwen
Parallel only when allowed_writes do not overlap
The same runner relaunches its own rework
Session Manager · AI Memory · Knowledge Base
Context Graph for the manager seat
Workers propose write intents, the manager approves
A learning commit after every accept or reject
focus · slice · body · bodygrep · calls · impact · testmap
PreToolUse guard: grep and raw reads are recorded fallbacks
Syntax · known-bug patterns · destructive diff · required outputs
Validation inside a Windows AppContainer sandbox
6 reviewer lenses, high-risk work needs a reviewer pair
The card runs, is reviewed, then accepted
A "Resolves: NF-…" commit trailer closes it automatically
VS Code extension · dashboard · manager console
